listing:
Basement room, Westmount Rd area. $700/mo. Jan 1 – Apr 30.

Cozy furnished room, own entrance, shared bath with one other student. Address: 303 Westmount Rd S, Waterloo (10 min drive, 15 min bus). Utilities included.

House rules (non-negotiable): Rent must land in my account by 9 am on the 1st. If you miss that, I will change the lock on the front door and put your belongings in the garage until the full balance is cleared. No excuses, I need this for my own lease. If you fail to pay by the 5th I'll consider you gone and rent to someone else. Viewing: Saturday. Sublet is fine with the landlord, he doesn't mind who lives here.
label_rationale: Self-help eviction clause. RTA s.24: 'A landlord shall not alter the locking system on a door giving entry to a rental unit ... during the tenant's occupancy ... without giving the tenant replacement keys'. s.39: 'A landlord shall not recover possession of a rental unit subject to a tenancy unless, (a) the tenant has vacated or abandoned the unit; or (b) an order of the Board evicting the tenant has authorized the possession.' s.40: 'No landlord shall, without legal process, seize a tenant's property for default in the payment of rent'. s.37(1): a tenancy may be terminated only in accordance with the Act. Everything else is ordinary, so HOLD. Uncertainty: low. The word 'eviction' is not used.
